component_provenance.A4-integration: Direct rigid placement of the released populated KiCad PCB STEP, including all board copper and library package solids. Component face points toward the floor.
component_provenance.A4-spacers: Three 3 x 3 x 2 mm electrically insulating blocks between A4 and A1. Verify 0.50 mm nominal A1 component clearance on the received assembly.
component_provenance.A4-bond: Two nominal 0.25 mm insulating adhesive bondlines per support. Check assembled thickness, peel, thermal exposure and pad position on the received unit.
component_provenance.A5-power: Direct placement of KiCad power daughterboard STEP on the A1 subassembly. The resistor thermal path, six point-to-point wires and controller net isolation need qualification.
component_provenance.A5-spacers: 3 x 3 x 2.7 mm electrically insulating spacers. Qualify bonded footprint, overhang and vibration.
component_provenance.A5-bond: Nominal 0.25 mm insulating adhesive bondlines on both faces of each support. Verify temperature and peel retention.
component_provenance.drvParts: Boardoza R1.0 source solids. The two R1/R2 pull-ups removed using the native PCB XY coordinates. Central bus pulls reside on A4.
